args.query: celery task just hangs forever no error, redis broker... also how do i retry when the external api is down

results.title: Celery 5 on Redis with fakeredis-backed idempotency, tested offline in eager mode
results.summary: Configure a Celery app on a Redis broker and result backend for production, guard a task with a Redis SET NX idempotency lock, and test it offline with task_always_eager and fakeredis.

results.title: Django post_save signal enqueuing a Celery task, tested with eager mode and on_commit
results.summary: A post_save signal queues a Celery task only after the row commits via transaction.on_commit, then tests run offline on in-memory SQLite with Celery eager mode and pytest-django's on_commit capture.

results.title: Celery 5 tasks, chains and groups tested in eager mode
results.summary: Define Celery tasks, chain and fan them out with groups, then test them offline with task_always_eager and the in-memory broker.

results.title: redis-py pipelines and WATCH transactions tested with fakeredis
results.summary: Batch commands with redis-py pipelines and guard optimistic WATCH/MULTI transactions, tested fully offline against a shared in-memory fakeredis server.

results.title: Celery beat crontab schedules validated and run eagerly
results.summary: Define beat_schedule crontab entries, validate task names and schedule types before deploy, and test each scheduled call offline with task_always_eager.

results.title: result Ok / Err map and and_then error handling without exceptions
results.summary: Railway-oriented pipelines with the result library: chain fallible steps with map, map_err and and_then, recover with or_else, and turn exceptions into Err values via as_result.

results.title: RQ background jobs tested with fakeredis
results.summary: Enqueue Redis Queue (RQ) jobs and process them with a SimpleWorker against fakeredis, so queue tests run offline with no Redis server.

results.title: Boltons retry decorator and cached property helpers under pytest
results.summary: A signature-preserving retry decorator composed with boltons.funcutils.wraps, plus cacheutils cachedproperty and cachedmethod memoization tested offline with pytest.

results.title: Lark LALR calculator with a Transformer and error handling
results.summary: A small LALR arithmetic grammar parsed with lark and evaluated by a Transformer, plus how syntax errors and exceptions raised inside transformer methods surface.

results.title: Elysia API with TypeBox validation and guards, tested via app.handle on Node
results.summary: An Elysia 1.4 app with TypeBox schemas for params, query, body and responses, a guard with an API key check and custom error mapping, tested on Node with web-standard Request objects through app.handle and no open port.
